supporting_observations.claim: At 13:45:28 UTC, FILE-NWD-01 sent 640,000,221 originator bytes in an HTTP connection to PROXY-NWD-01 on port 8080. This establishes a large transfer to the proxy, but not its ultimate destination or payload.
A Kerberos service-ticket event for svc-archive and FILE-NWD-01$ records client IP 139.162.174.124 at 13:43:51 UTC, shortly before the large proxy transfer.
WS-NBLAKE-01, running mstsc.exe as nora.blake, connected to FILE-NWD-01 by RDP at about 13:34:30 UTC; the recorded connection duration was about 785 seconds, overlapping the large transfer.

The external-IP svc-archive event and the RDP session from the help-desk workstation are concerning in light of the supplied environment context, but the available records do not establish that either caused or was related to the transfer.
